items.title: Add DONE experience source lineage
items.context: Expose DONE summary, pitfalls, and delivery-check material as a structured done_experience source in source lineage and seed observation, with canonical key versioning and no helped settlement.
items.userSees: CLI JSON includes "sourceArtifactKind":"done_experience", "canonicalSourceKeyVersion":"proofbound.learning-source-key.v1", and a stable canonicalSourceKey for the same DONE story.

happy.desc: playbook_seed_observe reports a done_experience seed for a DONE story with summary and delivery material.
The same DONE story produces a stable done_experience canonicalSourceKey and canonicalSourceKeyVersion across repeated observations.

edge.desc: DONE stories with partial or missing optional fields do not crash observation and either produce a bounded seed or a clear diagnostic.
Repeated observe/propose/approve for the same DONE story is deduped through canonical source representation and cannot create duplicate proposal or candidate rows.

adversarial.desc: DONE success alone does not write a helped playbook outcome or active runtime guidance.

items.title: Convert DONE experience seed into proposal and candidate
items.context: Reuse existing observe digest, batch proposal, and candidate approval flows so a reviewed DONE experience seed can become an inert candidate playbook.
items.userSees: The seed-to-candidate path is mechanically provable with CLI commands and digest guards.

happy.desc: playbook_seed_propose_batch --apply followed by playbook_candidate_batch_approve --apply creates a candidate from DONE experience.

edge.desc: observe/apply drift still fails when the observe digest changes.

adversarial.desc: The resulting playbook remains candidate/inert and is not returned as active runtime guidance.

items.title: Document DONE-experience candidate boundary
items.context: Update the execution documentation so DONE experience seeding is described as candidate material only, while activation remains outcome-gated.
items.userSees: The docs explain why Story 1 creates candidate material but does not automatically activate playbooks.

happy.desc: Docs name the DONE experience seed path and its safety boundary.

edge.desc: Docs distinguish new DONE experience from historical backfill.

adversarial.desc: Docs explicitly forbid counting DONE success alone as helped.
